name: Gradient Reveal Card
description: Bordered poster-style card with a dotted pattern. On hover a gradient sweeps across it, the card scales up, the icon brightens and the subtitle words rise in one by one.
contents: Bordered card with title and subtitle
Dot pattern layer behind the text
Font Awesome icon in the bottom left corner
behavior: Hover slides a three color gradient across the card and scales it
Dot pattern shifts position on hover
Subtitle words reveal with a staggered rise

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.

Hover only effect: on touch devices the reveal triggers on tap while pressed
